payload.reasoning_hinge_summary: The student must identify that in a parallel circuit, voltage is the invariant, necessitating the use of P = V²/R. They must then correctly scale resistance by the inverse square of the radius (R ∝ 1/r²) and combine these to find the power ratio.
payload.expected_mid_student_error: Using P = I²R and assuming current is constant, or failing to square the radius scaling factor when calculating the resistance change.
notes: The logic is sound and fits the ESAT difficulty profile perfectly.
The use of proportional reasoning instead of absolute values keeps the math clean and focused on the physics.
The distractors are well-mapped to common conceptual pitfalls.
